notes: Paper presents a projected 90% CL sensitivity for ultralight U(1)_{B-L} vector dark matter using optomechanical cavities (Fig 5), for resonance frequencies f0=0.1,1,10 Hz. Best projected limit gB-L ~ 7e-26 at low masses over valid range 5e-20 to 5e-15 eV. Coupling type is VectorBL (B-L gauge boson), NOT generic ScalarBaryon despite the pre-analysis hint - the paper explicitly gauges U(1)_{B-L}. Data points are approximate reads off the f0=0.1 Hz (best) curve; exact tabulated values not provided. Frequency->mass conversion m[eV]=4.14e-15*f[Hz] applied. Appendix E also derives an updated MICROSCOPE fifth-force bound (|eps_BL| <~ 8.93e-19 in EM-relative units, or gB-L <~ 7e-26), a recast (not haloscope). dm_density assumed as GeV/cm^3 (~0.3) via a0=sqrt(2rho/3)/u. | vector-trace candidate: b-l.pdf colour (0.52, 0.19, 0.44), 29 pts (selected among 6) | selector: vector_trace over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3.5, 0, 0.85, 29))
